description: Source code for the rlc_tx_um_entity class implementing RLC UM transmission logic, including SDU handling, PDU creation, buffer management, and metrics collection in a 5G NR context.

classes.name: rlc_tx_um_entity
classes.description: Class managing the transmission side of RLC Unacknowledged Mode (UM) entities, handling SDU queuing, PDU segmentation, and buffer state updates.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs, assigns PDCP sequence numbers, and queues them for transmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards SDUs with specified PDCP SN from the queue.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Creates PDUs from queued SDUs based on available grant size, handles segmentation, and updates transmission state.

methods.name: get_si_and_expected_header_size
methods.description: Determines the segmentation indicator and header size for a PDU based on SDU size and grant.

methods.name: handle_changed_buffer_state
methods.description: Triggers an update of the buffer state to the lower layer if not already pending.

methods.name: update_mac_buffer_state
methods.description: Calculates and sends the current buffer state to the lower layer.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state, including pending bytes and head length.
